title: Historical K-Index Dataset: Global Coordination Capacity (1996-2020)
description: The K-Index measures humanity's collective capacity for coordination on a 0-1 scale. This dataset provides annual measurements across seven harmonies (Governance, Interconnection, Trust, Complexity, Knowledge, Wellbeing, Technology) for the period 1996-2020. The K-Index is calculated as the geometric mean of all seven harmonies: K = [H1 × H2 × H3 × H4 × H5 × H6 × H7]^(1/7). A critical threshold (Golden Threshold θ = 0.382 = 1/φ²) marks the boundary below which coordination collapse risk increases significantly.
notes: Data sources include V-Dem (governance), World Bank (trade, education, health), World Values Survey (trust), and various technology indicators. Full methodology available in accompanying documentation.
